mentions.note: police constable; received an award for bravery during police service, shown on television

Belgrave vice-president and one-time member of the club's distance walking teams; policeman: King's Police Medal 1928 (Thames rescue at Westminster), British Empire Medal 1941 (bombed building rescue), £15 Police Reward Fund award and later George Medal for arresting smash-and-grab raiders, Sloane Street, 17 April 1951

share.d: Fred Stone in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1951–1976: 4 mentions in 4 issues.
